reason: The README describes a Zotero-focused research retrieval plugin that indexes papers, performs hybrid and graph-based search, and produces evidence-checked paper details and comparisons.

summaries.zh: 面向 Zotero 论文库提供混合检索、论文细节卡、证据引文和多篇论文对比功能。
summaries.en: Provides hybrid search, evidence-linked paper detail cards, and multi-paper comparisons for Zotero libraries.

capabilities: reads local Zotero SQLite databases and PDF full text
performs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval
optionally calls external embedding or language-model APIs
generates paper detail cards, comparisons, and evidence snippets
writes local configuration, index, and cache files
